raw.title: Chief Customer Officer
raw.excerpt: Work from anywhere, impact everywhere Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
raw.description:
Work from anywhere, impact everywhere

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
We’re a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position

Work from anywhere!

Position overview

Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship.

Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible.

The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision.

The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against.

This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep.

The mandate

  1. Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional.
    You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down.
  2. Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would.
    You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved.
  3. Win the right members, efficiently.
    You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it.
  4. Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances.
    Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost.
  5. Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless.
    You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay.
  6. Build one Customer organisation, not four.
    Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week.
  7. Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call.
    You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations.

How you'll operate

This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here.

  • You lead from inside the work. You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them.
  • You move people with the business case, not the whip. When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title.
  • You have extreme ownership. You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach.
  • You have genuine gravitas. Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger.
  • You diagnose before you prescribe. You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom.

What you'll have done

  • 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime).
  • Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don't need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don't need banking explained to you either.
  • Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC.
  • Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app.
  • Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product's economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage.
  • Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that's sustainable and growth that's borrowed from tomorrow's risk appetite.
  • A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn't support them, and outcomes you can prove.

The first 90 days

Day 30: The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board.Day 60: The unified Customer operating model is live: one set of key results across Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design, read weekly from one source. Every mission PM owns a product's contribution and its price, and the roadmap is ranked on what it earns, built with Finance and the line leads.Day 90: At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week.

What this role is not

  • Not a requirements-gathering role. Mission PMs are bankers who own a product's contribution and price, not a backlog. You partner with Technology, Finance, and Operations on execution; you don't run those functions.
  • Not a volume role. If your primary output is card spend, transfer volume, or a shipped list rather than assets held and the margin they earn, we have both failed.
  • Not a reporting layer. If your primary output is a customer-insight deck or a roadmap deck, we have both failed.
  • Not a role that can be done from a distance. Remote-first means distributed, not detached.

Other requirements

  • A dedicated workspace.
  • A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
  • Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

Why work for Xapo?

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

  • Shape the Future
    Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

  • Great work-life balanceBuild amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.

  • Expect ExcellenceCollaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

You are paid per accepted submission (piecework, independent contractor); submissions that break the rules are not paid. Payouts are made in the app (PayPal, Venmo or a Solana wallet).

raw.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/05/2026

This is a remote-friendly role! While we are open to remote candidates, we have a strong preference for those located in Pacific Time Zone.

Meet the Team

You will join Cisco’s Legal Innovation Strategy and Technology (“LIST”) organization as an Executive Assistant to provide high-impact administrative support to senior leadership. The LIST organization focuses on Intellectual Property; Open Source; AI Governance, Licensing & Enablement; Data Governance; Innovation Strategy; Privacy; Cybersecurity; Mergers & Acquisitions; and Incubation. LIST’s priorities include AI acceleration, enablement and responsible adoption, IP Strategy and protection, Data Usage and Governance, Open Source Compliance, Cisco Innovation Priorities, Cybersecurity, Data, Privacy, AI Regulations and Compliance, and Growth Opportunities.


In this role you will be a trusted partner to senior legal leaders, keeping their calendars, travel, meetings and communications running smoothly so they can focus on the legal and business priorities of the organization. You will work with a high degree of discretion, exercise sound judgment on competing priorities, and act as a leader within Cisco’s administrative community.


Your Impact

Responsibilities include:

  • Calendar Management: Management of VP's calendar and daily schedule to include prioritizing conflicting meeting requests, supervising action items and commitments of executive and following up to ensure completion. This will require outstanding organization skills, prioritizing multiple priorities and keeping a lively executive on track and on schedule.
  • Event Speaking Engagement Coordination: Responsible for a running list of VP's engagements and works closely with communications team to ensure content needs are understood and set in motion, so the VP is prepared for each engagement.
  • Meeting Planning and Organization: Assisting VP in planning and coordinating meetings by taking ownership for assembling the agenda, location, accommodating technology requirements based upon participant needs, and all other meeting logistics. May further prepare meeting briefing documents by taking and disseminating notes and formulating post meeting action item list.
  • Travel Briefing Preparation: Crafting travel packs for international trips. This work includes combining all event information in addition to coordinated logistics of travel and also customer/team asks.
  • Correspondence/Approvals: Supporting VP by acting as proxy for communications and approvals as authorized. Answering general questions as crucial, referring (filtering) routine matters to appropriate parties, and following up to ensure accurate disposition. Taking initiative to resolve issues within specified policies and guidelines and providing mentorship to administrative community members on problem solving. Resolving when executive action is required and supplying a recommendation where appropriate.
  • Travel and Expense Management: Responsible for making in-depth global travel arrangements for VP. Carefully considers and decides the optimum travel arrangements and itinerary for calendared meetings while handling Cisco expenses. Works diligently to go above and beyond, working with the airlines directly to accommodate Global Services benefits for upgrades whenever they are available.
  • Special Projects: Providing analytical support to assist executive on special projects. Researching issues, analyzing problems, compiling data, and preparing reports.
  • Large Corporate Events: Prepare and brief itinerary as well as accompany VP for large Corporate Events such as GSX, where EA's are used for executive support.
  • Confidentiality: Candidate will deal expertly with highly critical and confidential matters and materials.
  • Mentorship: Mentor new Executive Administrative Assistants and other administrators. Participates in a cross-functional EA network and will lead the organization’s community of Admins.

In addition to general administrative duties of an EA, daily tasks are carried out at a higher level of complexity. Specifically, the critical behaviors of this role are:

  • Self-motivated and proactive around needs of the VP and the Organization
  • Able to operate successfully with limited direction and ambiguity
  • Use tact, subtlety and a practical knowledge of company policies, practices and procedures
  • Responsiveness to all levels of inquiry
  • Challenge ‘the way we’ve always done it’ and provide a deeper more innovative way of doing things
  • Keep the big picture in mind when making independent decisions that affect the VP’s calendar
  • Have the ability to exercise critical and independent judgment with the VP’s calendar and time
  • Organized and efficient with their own time
  • Able to think creatively and calmly when it comes to quick and unplanned changes in schedule
  • Earn administrative community respect and have the ability to work with and through others as needed

You take initiative, can handle a full desk with ease and thrive in a lively environment. You have high-energy with a passion for thinking bigger and broader than the role itself. This position requires strong interpersonal skills, independent judgment, utmost integrity and ability to balance both strategic and tactical actions. You have outstanding attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information. You enjoy a collaborative environment, are committed to improvement, solve problems and make decisions. You have a proven ability to multitask and work in a focused manner. You are comfortable working without instruction on routine tasks and very little instruction on new projects.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years’ experience in administrative environment, and a minimum of 2 years supporting at the VP level or above.
  • Expert level knowledge of Windows desktop computer applications: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience in calendar management, planning meetings and coordinating travel.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills including the ability to connect with all levels of Executive/Senior staff and clients.
  • Ability to navigate web and email at high competency knowledge.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS or equivalent experience
  • Past work experience in the high-tech industry

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada:

The starting salary range posted for this position is $104,500.00 to $135,200.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

  • .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

  • 1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;

  • 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

  • Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

The applicable full salary ranges for this position, by specific state, are listed below:

New York City Metro Area:

$117,100.00 - $178,500.00

Non-Metro New York state & Washington state:

$104,500.00 - $155,400.00

* For quota-based sales roles on Cisco’s sales plan, the ranges provided in this posting include base pay and sales target incentive compensation combined.

** Employees in Illinois, whether exempt or non-exempt, will participate in a unique time off program to meet local requirements.

raw.description:
A Remote Opportunity Built for Growth

If you’re looking for a position where you can work with people, develop new skills, and create a long-term career path, this could be a great fit.

We’re growing our virtual team and looking for dependable, motivated individuals to work directly with members who are seeking information and assistance. You’ll help make the process easier by answering questions, explaining available options, and providing support from the initial conversation through enrollment and follow-up.

New to the industry? That’s completely fine. Previous experience is not required. Training, coaching, and ongoing support are provided to help you learn the position and develop professionally.

A Typical Day in the Role

Your day will primarily involve communicating with members through scheduled phone and virtual appointments. You’ll listen to their needs, provide information, and help them complete the necessary steps.

Your responsibilities may include:

  • Conducting virtual and phone appointments with members.
  • Asking questions to understand individual needs and priorities.
  • Presenting available programs and explaining options clearly.
  • Answering questions and helping members make informed decisions.
  • Assisting with applications, enrollment, and digital paperwork.
  • Following up on outstanding requests or documentation.
  • Maintaining organized and accurate client records.
  • Providing friendly, professional, and reliable service.

The Qualities We Value

Rather than looking for one specific professional background, we’re looking for individuals with the right attitude, communication skills, and willingness to develop.

You’ll likely do well in this position if you:

  • Enjoy interacting with and helping people.
  • Communicate confidently and professionally.
  • Listen carefully and pay attention to details.
  • Stay organized and manage your time effectively.
  • Can remain productive while working independently from home.
  • Are comfortable using basic computer and virtual communication tools.
  • Welcome coaching and opportunities to improve.
  • Take responsibility for your goals and results.
  • Enjoy being part of a collaborative and supportive team.

Experience in customer service, hospitality, retail, administration, sales, or other client-focused roles can be helpful, but it is not required.

Support, Flexibility & Opportunity

From the beginning, you’ll have access to resources designed to help you learn the position and continue progressing.

  • 100% remote work
  • Flexible scheduling
  • Full training provided
  • Ongoing mentorship and coaching
  • Weekly compensation
  • Performance-based earning opportunities
  • Opportunity to build recurring residual income
  • Performance-based company travel incentives
  • Leadership development
  • Career advancement opportunities

Where This Opportunity Can Take You

For individuals interested in long-term growth, this role provides room to take on more responsibility as you gain experience and strengthen your skills. Team members who demonstrate strong performance and leadership abilities can pursue opportunities in training, mentorship, and management.

If you’re motivated to learn, enjoy working with people, and want the flexibility of a remote career with room to grow, we encourage you to apply and learn more about the opportunity.

raw.excerpt: About UsRed Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security.
raw.description:
About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

About Trase

Co-founded in 2023 by Joe Laws and Grant Verstandig, Trase Systems is AI, Uncomplicated. Trase empowers enterprise leaders to harness the full potential of AI without the associated complexity and risks. We are an end-to-end solution for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI in the enterprise. Our platform specializes in bridging the “last mile” of AI adoption, unlocking AI's full potential while driving efficiency and significant cost savings. Trase is at the forefront of AI Agent innovation, topping the Hugging Face GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, ahead of industry giants such as Google, Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI. We are leveraging our cutting-edge technologies to develop mission-critical agentic applications in complex industries such as Healthcare, Oil & Gas, and National Security.

About the Role

We are seeking an Engineering Leader to build and lead our Production and Infrastructure Engineering organization. You will manage engineers across DevOps, SRE, DevEx, MLOps, and lead a dedicated support team. You will be accountable for team performance, development, and delivery across these functions.

You will bring a strong foundation in infrastructure and software engineering and stay close enough to the work to challenge assumptions, guide technical decisions, and help engineers resolve difficult problems. Your hands-on involvement will focus on design and code reviews, technical investigation, and pairing when needed, while developing technical leads and delegating implementation to the team.

This role calls for a nimble, adaptable leader who can organize ambiguous work, adjust plans as priorities change, and bring different technical disciplines together around clear outcomes. You will create focus, make timely decisions, and build a team that delivers consistently.

Responsibilities

  • Build and Develop the Team: Own hiring, onboarding, one-on-ones, career development, and performance management. Coach junior engineers, develop technical leads, and give senior specialists clear expectations and candid feedback. Build the skills and ownership needed for the team to operate effectively.
  • Lead Across Technical Disciplines: Set shared priorities and clear responsibilities across infrastructure, reliability, developer experience, testing, and application delivery. Delegate technical execution to the appropriate leads, resolve disagreements, and hold engineers at every level accountable to agreed decisions and commitments.
  • Own Planning and Delivery: Lead sprint planning, backlog grooming, capacity planning, and delivery reviews in partnership with technical leads and TPMs. Turn ambiguous goals into actionable work, manage dependencies and scope, and balance roadmap delivery with incidents and customer support. Replan quickly and communicate tradeoffs when conditions change.
  • Provide Hands-On Technical Leadership: Participate in design and code reviews, ask informed questions, and join investigations or pairing sessions when the team is blocked. Use your infrastructure and software background to connect application behavior with deployment and operational concerns and guide practical solutions.
  • Lead Production and Release Readiness: Make reliability, release and change management, QA, and E2E validation part of the team's delivery process. Assign accountable owners, establish readiness criteria with feature teams, and ensure testing, operational documentation, and rollback plans support release decisions.
  • Strengthen Operations and Developer Experience: Lead the team's improvements to cloud infrastructure, automation, CI/CD, observability, on-call readiness, and incident response. Prioritize work that reduces recurring incidents and developer friction. Use delivery, reliability, recovery, and support metrics to assess results and guide investment.
  • Lead Dedicated Red Cell Partners Support: Manage a cross-functional team of full-stack engineers, DevOps engineers, and a dedicated TPM. Align priorities, staffing, delivery commitments, and support expectations with stakeholders. Resolve dependencies across application and infrastructure teams and maintain clear escalation paths.
  • Partner Across the Organization: Work with Product, Platform, Applied AI, and Security/GRC on delivery priorities, operational readiness, and applicable customer requirements. Surface risks early, secure decisions when needed, and ensure follow-through on engineering commitments.

Requirements

  • Engineering People Leadership: 10+ years of relevant engineering experience, including 5+ years of direct engineering people management, or equivalent demonstrated experience. A track record of building teams, coaching engineers (platform, infrastructure), managing performance, and delivering through technical leads. Director-level candidates should demonstrate leadership across multiple engineering functions.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Experience leading teams with different technical specialties and seniority levels. Strong planning, prioritization, delegation, and stakeholder communication; able to resolve technical disagreements and keep teams aligned to shared outcomes.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: A strong technical foundation in at least one major cloud platform, such as GCP, AWS, or Azure, with practical experience in Kubernetes, containers, networking, identity, and production operations.
  • Infrastructure as Code and Delivery Automation: Practical experience with Terraform, Git-based development workflows, GitOps, and CI/CD. Able to guide the team's approach to repeatable environments, configuration control, and reliable deployments.
  • Software Engineering: A strong background building and shipping production software, with working depth across backend services, APIs, data stores, and full-stack integration. Able to review code and designs, reason about application failures, and pair with engineers to unblock delivery.
  • Operational and Quality Leadership: Experience leading production delivery and support, including reliability, incident response, release and change management, and collaboration with engineers on automated testing and E2E readiness.
  • Adaptability and Ownership: Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguity, learn unfamiliar technical domains, and make timely decisions with incomplete information. Comfortable shifting between people leadership, delivery issues, and technical discussions while maintaining team focus.
  • Customer and Partner Collaboration: Experience managing technical commitments and escalations with internal or external customers, and translating their needs into feasible priorities and delivery plans.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with MLOps, model serving, or operating AI/ML and agent workloads; able to learn from and partner with specialists in these areas.
  • Experience supporting customer-managed environments, multiple cloud providers, or enterprise deployments with complex integration needs.
  • Experience in national security, federal, regulated, or other security-sensitive environments and partnering with Security/GRC on engineering requirements.
  • Experience scaling an engineering organization or building a new team or operating function in a fast-changing company.

Certain national security assignments may require U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a security clearance, depending on confirmed customer and contract requirements. Some travel is required.

If you want to be on the cutting edge of technology, building AI solutions for the future, and are up for a challenge, let’s talk!

Salary Range: $240,000-290,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

Our Red Cell Partners Benefits (may differ for each incubation):

For full-time roles

  • Career track opportunity with potential for rapid advancement with strong performance as the firm grows
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health care including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family.
  • Paid maternity and paternity for 14 weeks at employees' normal pay.
  • Unlimited PTO, with management approval.
  • Opportunities for professional development and continued learning.
  • Optional 401K, FSA, and equity incentives available.
  • Mental health benefits are available through Tara Mind.
  • Cost effective GLP-1 solutions available through Crux.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer: You’ll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

Applicant Data Disclosure

By submitting an application, you acknowledge that Red Cell Partners, LLC ("Red Cell") uses third-party service providers to facilitate its recruitment and hiring processes. These providers include applicant tracking systems, candidate verification platforms, and fraud detection tools (collectively, "Hiring Platforms"). Your application materials, including your résumé, cover letter, work samples, responses to application questions, and any other information you submit, may be transmitted to and processed by these Hiring Platforms for the following purposes:

  • Managing and administering your application throughout the hiring process;
  • Verifying the accuracy and authenticity of application materials, including by cross-referencing information you provide against publicly available sources and proprietary databases;
  • Identifying indicators of potentially fraudulent, fabricated, or materially misleading application content, including but not limited to discrepancies between submitted materials and publicly available professional profiles, geographic anomalies, and fabricated work histories.

Applications that are flagged through this process as containing indicators of fraud or material misrepresentation may be declined from further consideration. If you have questions about the status of your application or the evaluation process, please contact .

Red Cell requires its Hiring Platform providers to process your information solely for the purposes described above and in accordance with applicable law. Your information will be retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill these purposes and any applicable legal obligations, after which it will be deleted in accordance with Red Cell's data retention policies.

For more information about how your data is used, please refer to our Privacy Policy and Applicant Privacy Notice.

raw.description:
About this role:

The Account Executive is a field sales role responsible for client retention and growth. Account Executives build trust-based relationships with C-Level Executives and their teams. They understand the mission-critical priorities of their clients and ensure clients receive the value from the Gartner relationship that they expect, while also identifying opportunities for stronger value delivery with alternative product offerings.

Account Executives will be given a territory of Large Enterprise clients.

In our End-User Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$1bil in annual revenue.

In our Tech Vendor Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$500mil in annual revenue.

What you will do:

  • Drive value delivery with current Gartner clients, ensuring clients maximize the value they receive from their Gartner services

  • Identify, cultivate, qualify and close client growth opportunities through cross-sell and upsell

  • Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics, ensuring KPI’s are met.

  • Quota responsibility for your assigned territory.

  • Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments.

  • Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.

What you will need:

  • 5-8+ years' B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments

  • Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives

  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets.

  • Proven ability to own, manage, and forecast a complex sales process.

  • Willingness to conduct travel as needed.

  • Bachelor's degree preferred

What you will get:

  • Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, and more!

  • Uncapped commission structure

  • World-class sales training programs and skill development programs

  • Annual “Winners Circle” event attendance at exclusive destinations for top performers

  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces inclusion

  • Professional development and career growth opportunities

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 101,000 USD - 140,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.

raw.description:
The Opportunity

ShyftLabs is a fast-growing data and technology company partnering with Fortune 500 organizations to deliver innovative, data-driven solutions. We specialize in building scalable, enterprise-grade platforms that help businesses unlock the value of their data through modern cloud technologies, advanced analytics, and AI-driven capabilities.

We are seeking an experienced Data Architect to work directly with enterprise clients, providing architectural leadership and hands-on technical expertise across modern data engineering initiatives. This is a client-facing role that combines solution architecture, technical consulting, and delivery oversight, requiring the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and reliable data solutions.

You will collaborate closely with client stakeholders, engineering teams, and technology partners to define architectural direction, establish engineering standards, and guide data platform implementations from design through production. You will also review partner-developed architectures, code, data models, and pipelines to ensure solutions meet enterprise requirements and align with established best practices.

The ideal candidate is a technically strong, hands-on architect who can confidently engage with senior client stakeholders, communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and influence architectural decisions while supporting distributed engineering teams.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead Client-Facing Architecture Discussions: Work directly with client stakeholders to understand business objectives, technical requirements, existing data environments, and architectural challenges. Translate these needs into practical, scalable data architecture solutions.

  • Define Enterprise Data Architecture: Design and recommend modern data platform architectures using Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, and cloud-based data engineering technologies, ensuring alignment with client objectives and enterprise standards.

  • Drive Technical Discovery and Solution Design: Facilitate technical workshops, discovery sessions, and architecture reviews to assess current-state environments, identify gaps, evaluate solution options, and define target-state architectures.

  • Provide Hands-On Technical Leadership: Develop, validate, and review data engineering solutions using SQL, Python/PySpark, Apache Airflow, and dbt Core, balancing architectural oversight with practical implementation expertise.

  • Guide Data Pipeline Development: Establish architecture and implementation standards for ingestion pipelines that integrate APIs, databases, files, and cloud data sources using Databricks-native capabilities such as Lakeflow Connect and Auto Loader.

  • Establish Data Architecture Standards: Define and promote reusable architectural patterns, implementation guidelines, and engineering best practices across client projects and distributed delivery teams.

  • Implement Medallion Architecture: Design and guide the implementation of Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers to support reliable ingestion, standardized transformations, curated data products, and downstream analytics.

  • Drive Data Governance and Modeling: Establish appropriate practices for Unity Catalog, data access controls, lineage, semantic modeling, data discoverability, and enterprise data governance.

  • Oversee Technical Delivery and Quality: Review partner and engineering team deliverables, including architecture designs, code, data models, and pipelines, ensuring alignment with requirements, performance expectations, security standards, and long-term maintainability.

  • Champion Data Quality and Reliability: Define standards for data validation, automated testing, pipeline monitoring, error handling, and operational readiness to ensure reliable production data products.

  • Support CI/CD and Engineering Automation: Guide implementation of Git-based workflows, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and controlled deployment practices across development, testing, and production environments.

  • Advise on Performance and Cost Optimization: Evaluate platform performance, processing efficiency, scalability, and cloud consumption, recommending improvements that balance technical requirements with business value.

  • Drive AI-Assisted and Spec-Driven Development: Encourage the effective use of AI-assisted development tools and specification-driven engineering practices while maintaining architectural integrity, code quality, and delivery standards.

  • Coordinate Distributed Engineering Teams: Provide technical direction, resolve architectural questions, and facilitate collaboration between client stakeholders, internal engineers, and external technology partners.

  • Communicate Progress and Technical Risks: Clearly communicate architectural decisions, implementation trade-offs, dependencies, risks, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Support End-to-End Delivery: Maintain architectural ownership throughout the project lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing optimization.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years of overall experience in data engineering, data architecture, or related technical roles, with strong hands-on experience designing and delivering production-grade data platforms.

  • Proven experience in a client-facing technical role, such as Data Architect, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, or Lead Data Engineer, working directly with enterprise customers or stakeholders.

  • Strong hands-on expertise with Azure Databricks, including the design and implementation of scalable enterprise data solutions.

  • Deep understanding of Delta Lake, including data management, processing patterns, and performance optimization.

  • Experience with Unity Catalog, including data governance, access controls, lineage, and enterprise data management.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python/PySpark for data processing, transformation, and pipeline development.

  • Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow for orchestration and dbt Core for data transformation, testing, and modeling.

  • Experience designing ingestion pipelines across APIs, relational databases, files, and other enterprise data sources.

  • Familiarity with Databricks-native ingestion technologies, including Lakeflow Connect and Auto Loader.

  • Strong understanding of Medallion Architecture, data products, semantic modeling, and data quality frameworks.

  • Experience with CI/CD, Git, automated testing, monitoring, and production data pipeline management.

  • Demonstrated ability to review and challenge technical architectures, code, data models, and engineering deliverables while providing constructive, actionable feedback.

  • Experience translating business requirements into technical specifications, architectural designs, and implementation roadmaps.

  • Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and communicate recommendations clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders, and client leadership.

  • Experience working with external technology partners, third-party delivery teams, or distributed engineering organizations.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and spec-driven development practices.

  • Strong communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and build trusted relationships with clients while maintaining technical credibility.

Salary Range

  • $160,000 - $190,000 (CAD)

Why You’ll Love Working at ShyftLabs

At ShyftLabs, your work matters. We’re a growing data product company making a big impact with Fortune 500 clients and as we scale, you’ll have the chance to shape solutions, influence strategy, and grow your career alongside us.

Inclusion at ShyftLabs

We’re building something big, and we want you on the journey with us. If you’re ready to use data and innovation to make an impact, apply today and let’s grow together.

raw.description:
ABOUT KLED

Kled is building the largest opt-in human data network in the world.

We are not a labeling firm. We are not a task marketplace.

We are a consumer application where people upload their real photos, videos, and documents and get paid continuously.

We then filter, standardize, and license that data to frontier AI labs and enterprises that need fresh, rights-aware training data.

Since launching our mobile app in 2026, we have:

• Reached #1 on the App Store (Finance) with 0 paid marketing
• Scaled to 600,000+ active data contributors

• Processed 5M uploads per day

• Raised $15M+ from investors behind SpaceX, Airbnb, Coinbase, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Spotify, Lyft, Uber, and more

Our mission is to let anyone download the app and earn a real living wage from uploading their data.

This listing is for one paid task in the Kled app: "Same Screen, Different Display Settings". There is no interview and no minimum hours: download the app, open the task, and you are paid per accepted submission.

What you will do

Screenshot the same app screen three times: normal, dark mode, and with the text size turned right up.

Steps

  1. Pick one app screen

  2. Screenshot it as it normally looks

  3. Turn on dark mode and screenshot the same screen

  4. Increase text size to maximum and screenshot again

  5. Submit all shots together

What gets rejected

  • Do not change screens between variants

  • Do not send fewer than three variants

  • Do not crop differently between shots

Accepted: The same screen captured under three or more display settings.

Pay

$0.95 per accepted set. At a typical pace of about 3.5 minutes per set, that is about $16 per hour. A 20-minute session of about 6 sets pays about $5.70. One set of 3 to 4 screenshots per submission. You are paid per accepted submission (piecework, independent contractor); submissions that break the rules are not paid. Payouts are made in the app (PayPal, Venmo or a Solana wallet).

Where and when

Open worldwide: the task runs in 100+ countries. Remote, on your own schedule. Independent contractor, piecework; this is not an employment position.

What you need

  • An iPhone running iOS 18.6 or later (the Kled app is iPhone-only right now)

  • 18 or older

  • Screenshots taken on your own phone

How to start

  1. Download Kled from the App Store: (also at kled.ai/app).

  2. Create your account and open Tasks.

  3. Search "Same Screen, Different Display Settings", read the brief and follow the on-screen steps.

  4. Submit. Accepted submissions are paid in the app.

Every submission is reviewed, and you opt in to a commercial training license on each upload; accepted submissions are licensed to AI labs. Questions: .

• Reached #1 on the App Store (Finance) with 0 paid marketing

Our mission is to let anyone download the app and earn a real living wage from uploading their data.

This listing is for one paid task in the Kled app: "Code With Your Explanation". There is no interview and no minimum hours: download the app, open the task, and you are paid per accepted submission.

What you will do

Paste in code you wrote, a script, a function, a query, a spreadsheet formula, then explain what it does and why you built it that way.

Steps

  1. Paste code you wrote yourself

  2. Explain what it does

  3. Explain why you built it that way, and what approach you rejected

  4. Submit

What gets rejected

  • Do not paste code you did not write

  • Do not skip the reasoning stage

  • Do not submit two-line snippets

Accepted: Code you wrote yourself, plus an explanation of both what it does and why you chose that approach.

Pay

$7.00 per accepted sample. At a typical pace of about 12 minutes per sample, that is about $35 per hour. One sample takes about 12 minutes and pays $7.00. One sample per contributor. You are paid per accepted submission (piecework, independent contractor); submissions that break the rules are not paid. Payouts are made in the app (PayPal, Venmo or a Solana wallet).

Where and when

Open worldwide: the task runs in 100+ countries. Remote, on your own schedule. Independent contractor, piecework; this is not an employment position.

What you need

  • An iPhone running iOS 18.6 or later (the Kled app is iPhone-only right now)

  • 18 or older

  • Your own writing, typed in the app

How to start

  1. Download Kled from the App Store: (also at kled.ai/app).

  3. Search "Code With Your Explanation", read the brief and follow the on-screen steps.

  4. Submit. Accepted submissions are paid in the app.

raw.description:
About Ema

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Leader to manage and scale multiple product lines in the Voice, BPO, and Workforce Management space. This is a high-impact leadership role that sits at the intersection of real-time voice systems, operations research, and data-intensive platform engineering.

You will report directly to the Head of Engineering and own the engineering organization that builds the infrastructure powering Ema’s Voice AI Employees, Agent QA, auto-learning pipelines, rich analytics, and workforce optimization capabilities — all operating as scalable, multi-tenant systems deployed across global geographies.

You will collaborate with Product, ML/AI, and Go-to-Market teams to translate customer needs into production systems that handle high volumes of voice data, deliver real-time insights, and continuously improve through automated learning loops. As the owner of multiple product lines, you will balance roadmap priorities across Voice, BPO operations, and WFM (work force management) — ensuring each product evolves cohesively while meeting distinct customer needs.

What You Will Do

Scalable Multi-Tenant Systems

  • Architect and build multi-tenant systems that serve enterprise customers across geographies with strict data residency, isolation, and compliance requirements.

  • Design high-throughput ingestion systems capable of processing large volumes of voice data, call metadata, and operational telemetry in near real-time.

  • Make foundational architectural decisions on data stores, stream processing, and storage tiers — balancing query performance, cost, and operational simplicity.

  • Champion SOLID principles, clean architecture, and engineering rigor across all codebases — ensuring systems are testable, extensible, and maintainable at scale.

Team Building & Engineering Culture

  • Recruit, hire, and develop senior engineers across a multi-disciplinary function spanning voice engineering, backend systems, data engineering, and applied operations research.

  • Establish engineering standards, code review culture, and a strong bias toward shipping — with equal commitment to system reliability and customer experience.

  • Coach and grow senior/staff engineers into technical leaders; manage engineering managers as the organization scales.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment with Product, ML/AI, and Go-to-Market teams to ensure the platform evolves in lockstep with customer needs and market feedback.

Voice Platform & Agent QA

  • Own the end-to-end engineering for Ema’s AgentQA capabilities — real-time voice pipelines, telephony integrations, and voice-to-action workflows.

  • Build and scale the Agent QA platform: automated call scoring, compliance monitoring, sentiment analysis, and coaching feedback loops.

  • Design auto-learning systems that continuously improve voice agents from production interactions — closed-loop feedback, model retraining triggers, and quality regression detection.

  • Deliver rich voice analytics: call volume trends, handle time distributions, first-call resolution metrics, agent performance dashboards, and anomaly detection.

  • Build scalable voice pipeline across geographies – keeping in mind PII, security and compliance requirements.

Workforce Management & Operations Research

  • Build WFM capabilities including demand forecasting, shift scheduling, real-time adherence monitoring, and capacity planning — applying operations research techniques to optimize workforce utilization.

  • Design and implement optimization algorithms for headcount modeling, skill-based routing, and workload balancing across multi-site, multi-timezone contact center operations.

  • Partner with ML/AI teams to integrate predictive models for call volume forecasting, attrition risk, and staffing efficiency.

What We Look For

Required

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years leading engineering teams of 8+ engineers at high-growth startups or top-tier tech companies.

  • Deep expertise in building real-time, data-intensive systems.

  • Strong foundation in data stores and storage systems: relational databases, time-series stores, columnar analytics engines, and caching layers — with the judgment to choose the right tool for the workload.

  • Experience building quality software using AI-driven tools and workflows.

  • Track record of taking products from 0→1 and iterating rapidly based on customer feedback.

  • Hands-on proficiency with SOLID principles, clean architecture, and design patterns — you write and review production code and lead by example on system design.

  • Experience building scalable multi-tenant SaaS platforms with data isolation, geo-distributed deployments, and compliance requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA).

  • Track record of building ingestion systems for high volumes of load — event-driven architectures, stream processing (Kafka, Flink, or equivalent), and batch/real-time hybrid pipelines.

  • Strong product sense: ability to deeply understand customer problems in contact center, voice, and workforce domains and translate them into clean technical solutions.

  • Proven ability to hire, develop, and retain high-caliber engineers across multiple disciplines in competitive markets.

Good to have

  • Experience in voice/telephony systems: WebRTC, SIP, voice-over-IP infrastructure, or contact center platforms.

  • Background in operations research or optimization: scheduling algorithms, linear/integer programming, constraint satisfaction, or demand forecasting models.

  • Experience building analytics platforms: OLAP systems, real-time dashboards, metric computation engines, or BI infrastructure.

  • Prior work on auto-learning or continuous improvement systems: feedback loops from production data, automated retraining pipelines, or quality monitoring systems.

  • Experience with AI/ML-powered products in enterprise settings — agentic automation, LLM orchestration, or AI-driven UX.

  • Familiarity with WFM or contact center operations — staffing models, Erlang-based capacity planning, or real-time adherence systems.

Why Ema

  • Build at the intersection of Voice AI, operations research, and enterprise-scale systems — a rare combination of deeply technical challenges with direct customer impact.

  • Shape the engineering foundation of a category-defining AI platform — your architectural decisions will power how the world’s largest enterprises run their voice and workforce operations.

  • High-impact, high-visibility role with direct access to the Head of Engineering, co-founders, and enterprise customers.

  • A team of exceptional engineers from Google, Meta, Microsoft Research, and top CS programs worldwide.

  • Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and the opportunity to build something that matters.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

Position Title: FP&A Analyst (Healthcare)

Location: Remote

Travel Required: Less than 5%

Who we are:

US Health Partners (“USHP”) seeks to redefine high-quality specialty care in the United States and establish a high-performing, technology-enabled care delivery platform. USHP is partnering with the country's leading physicians to build a comprehensive, out-patient focused specialty care network targeting the nation's cardiovascular concerns. Our physician-led organization is passionate about supporting exceptional care and enriching the lives of patients across the United States. We envision the opportunity to create a scaled, cutting-edge, technology-enabled healthcare services platform that leverages a value-based delivery model.

Position Summary:

The FP&A Analyst is an experienced contributor to the finance team, playing a key role in the company's budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting processes. This role independently builds and maintains financial models, monitors performance against budget, and delivers polished reporting and analysis that inform leadership decision-making. This is a strong opportunity for an experienced finance professional to deepen their FP&A expertise and take on greater ownership within a growing, physician-led healthcare organization.

Responsibilities may include:

Budgeting and Forecasting:

  • -Lead the preparation of components of the annual budget and periodic financial forecasts, working directly with department and business unit leaders.
  • -Consolidate and validate inputs from cross-functional departments, ensuring accuracy and alignment with corporate goals.
  • -Track actual performance against budget and forecast, identify variances, and develop clear explanations and recommendations for leadership.

Financial Reporting and Analysis:

  • -Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
  • -Independently conduct financial analysis to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement, and translate findings into actionable insights.
  • -Build and maintain supporting schedules, dashboards, and executive-ready summaries for leadership review.
  • -Prepare revenue recognition reports as part of the close process, ensuring accurate accruals, cutoffs, and reconciliations across all practices.

Business Partnering:

  • -Serve as a day-to-day finance partner to assigned business units, providing financial insights and guidance to support decision-making.
  • -Proactively respond to data requests from business units and anticipate follow-on questions from leadership.
  • -Lead scenario analysis and ad hoc financial calculations to support business decisions and investment discussions.

Process Improvement:

  • -Identify and lead opportunities to streamline financial models, reports, and recurring processes.
  • -Maintain data integrity and consistency across financial systems and reporting tools, and recommend improvements where gaps are identified.
  • -Document and continuously improve FP&A processes and procedures, and help train junior team members on best practices.

Ad-hoc Analysis:

  • -Lead ad-hoc financial analysis and reporting as requested by the FP&A team or senior management.
  • -Provide analytical support for special projects, business initiatives, and cross-functional strategic efforts as needed.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

Experience:

  • -3–5 years of experience in FP&A, financial analysis, accounting, or a related role; healthcare or multi-site company experience is a plus.
  • -Solid understanding of financial modeling, forecasting, and budgeting techniques, with demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • -Strong proficiency with Excel; experience with financial planning tools or ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) is a plus.

Competencies:

  • -Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize large, complex data sets into clear, actionable insights.
  • -Confident written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present financial information to non-financial stakeholders.
  • -Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy and the ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • -Strong business acumen and the ability to build effective working relationships across cross-functional teams.
  • -Experience with business intelligence (BI) tools and data visualization software (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is a plus.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands and fingers to handle or feel, as well as talk and hear. The employee is regularly required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is required to stand and walk. The employee may lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist

Remote | Gastroenterology | Part-Time, 40 hours/week | Rate: $6.5/hour

About the Role

This Gastroenterology practice is looking for a highly organized, patient-focused Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist to support its clinics in two locations in Texas.

This role is heavily focused on appointment scheduling and patient communication, with a high daily call volume of approximately 70 to 90 calls per day. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced healthcare environment, managing multiple communication channels, and maintaining accurate patient documentation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Appointment Scheduling

  • Handle approximately 70 to 90 inbound and outbound calls daily related to appointments for the Lewisville and Denton locations.

  • Schedule, reschedule, and cancel patient appointments while ensuring accurate and timely communication with patients.

  • Maintain and update provider schedules in RingCentral and eClinicalWorks (eCW) based on availability and scheduling requirements.

2. Fax Management

  • Send and receive faxes involving patient records, referrals, insurance documents, and other clinical or administrative information.

  • Review incoming fax communications and route documents to the appropriate provider, department, or patient record.

  • Accurately log, upload, and organize faxed documentation within the clinic's systems.

3. Language Interpretation Support

  • Provide occasional language interpretation assistance between patients and clinic staff when needed.

  • Help ensure medical and administrative information is communicated clearly and accurately across language barriers.

  • Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and accuracy when assisting with patient-provider communication.

4. Outbound Calling

  • Conduct outbound calls for appointment reminders, follow-ups, patient updates, and care coordination.

  • Contact insurance companies, referring providers, pharmacies, or other healthcare offices when necessary.

  • Document call outcomes, follow-up requirements, and relevant information accurately in the patient's record.

5. Patient Text Messaging

  • Send appointment confirmations, reminders, updates, and other approved patient communications through text messaging.

  • Monitor and collect patient responses and escalate questions or concerns to the appropriate clinic team member when needed.

  • Document relevant text conversations and patient responses in RingCentral and eCW to maintain continuity of care.

6. Billing and Payment Reminder Support

  • Contact patients regarding outstanding balances, billing reminders, or upcoming payment obligations as instructed by the clinic.

  • Provide basic payment-related information and direct patients to the appropriate billing resource when additional assistance is required.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in medical administration, medical virtual assistance, patient scheduling, front desk support, or a similar healthcare role is strongly preferred.

  • Comfortable handling a high-volume call environment, including approximately 70 to 90 calls per day.

  • Experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW) and RingCentral is highly preferred.

  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills with a professional and patient-friendly approach.

  • Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and ability to manage multiple tasks throughout the workday.

  • Experience supporting a gastroenterology or specialty medical practice is an advantage.

  • Ability to communicate in an additional language and provide interpretation support is an advantage.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is confident speaking with patients throughout the day, comfortable managing a high volume of appointments and communications, and able to stay organized while supporting two clinic locations. You should be dependable, detail-oriented, professional, and capable of providing a positive patient experience while maintaining accurate documentation.

ABOUT KLED

Kled is building the largest opt-in human data network in the world.

We are not a labeling firm. We are not a task marketplace.

We are a consumer application where people upload their real photos, videos, and documents and get paid continuously.

We then filter, standardize, and license that data to frontier AI labs and enterprises that need fresh, rights-aware training data.

Since launching our mobile app in 2026, we have:

• Reached #1 on the App Store (Finance) with 0 paid marketing
• Scaled to 600,000+ active data contributors

• Processed 5M uploads per day

• Raised $15M+ from investors behind SpaceX, Airbnb, Coinbase, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Spotify, Lyft, Uber, and more

Our mission is to let anyone download the app and earn a real living wage from uploading their data.

This listing is for one paid task in the Kled app: "Transit Departure Boards". There is no interview and no minimum hours: download the app, open the task, and you are paid per accepted submission.

What you will do

Photograph departure boards and timetables, bus, train, ferry, airport, or a printed schedule on a wall.

Steps

  1. Photograph the departure board or timetable

  2. Hold steady so the display is not smeared

  3. Upload

What gets rejected

  • Do not send heavily smeared shots

  • Do not crop off the header row

  • No people in frame

Accepted: Display or timetable readable, including LED and dot-matrix boards.

Pay

$0.30 per accepted photo. At a typical pace of about 1 minute per photo, that is about $18 per hour. A 20-minute session of about 20 photos pays about $6.00. Up to 50 photos per upload. You are paid per accepted submission (piecework, independent contractor); submissions that break the rules are not paid. Payouts are made in the app (PayPal, Venmo or a Solana wallet).

Where and when

Open in 11 Southeast Asian countries, including Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam. Remote, on your own schedule. Independent contractor, piecework; this is not an employment position.

What you need

  • An iPhone running iOS 18.6 or later (the Kled app is iPhone-only right now)

  • 18 or older

  • Your phone camera, used inside the Kled app

How to start

  1. Download Kled from the App Store: (also at kled.ai/app).

  2. Create your account and open Tasks.

  3. Search "Transit Departure Boards", read the brief and follow the on-screen steps.

  4. Submit. Accepted submissions are paid in the app.

Every submission is reviewed, and you opt in to a commercial training license on each upload; accepted submissions are licensed to AI labs. Questions: .

SyBridge Technologies is at the forefront of technology-enabled design, prototyping, and manufacturing solutions for complex, high-precision parts. As North America's largest injection molding tooling platform and the leading private on-demand digital manufacturer, we are driven by cutting-edge AI/ML technology.
