About Crestview Partners:

Founded in 2004, Crestview is a value-oriented private equity firm focused on the middle market with approximately $10 billion in capital commitments. Based in New York, Crestview focuses on
industrials, media, and financial services.

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Network & Security Engineer to design, implement, manage, and secure enterprise network infrastructure across multiple locations. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Layer 3 networking, enterprise firewalls, cybersecurity technologies, and IT security best practices. This role will be responsible for maintaining secure and reliable connectivity between sites, cloud environments, remote users, and manufacturing or business operations.

The successful candidate must be proactive, security-focused, and capable of independently troubleshooting complex network and security issues in a remote work environment.

Candidates must demonstrate hands-on experience with both wired and wireless enterprise networking environments and be capable of independently designing, implementing, securing, and troubleshooting Layer 3 and Wi-Fi network infrastructures. Preference will be given to candidates with experience supporting manufacturing facilities, warehouses, and multi-site operations.

Key Responsibilities

Network Engineering:

  • Design, deploy, and maintain enterprise Layer 3 network infrastructure. Configure and manage routing protocols including BGP, EIGRP (preferred), Static Routing.
  • Implement and manage VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, subnetting, IP addressing plans, and network segmentation.
  • Troubleshoot complex LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, and VPN connectivity issues.
  • Manage network switches, routers, wireless infrastructure, and edge connectivity.
  • Design, deploy, and manage enterprise Wi-Fi across multiple sites, including site surveys, RF and coverage optimization, troubleshooting, controllers, access points, guest networks, and security policies.
  • Optimize network performance, redundancy, and high availability.

Security Engineering:

  • Manage remote-access and site-to-site VPNs, firewalls, and security appliances.
  • Maintain firewall policies, NAT rules, VPN configurations, security zones, and remediate vulnerabilities.
  • Monitor and respond to security events using Zero Trust and least-privilege principles.

Cybersecurity Operations:

  • Deploy and administer EDR, SIEM, vulnerability management, MFA, IAM, email security, and PAM tools.
  • Participate in incident response and forensic investigations.
  • Support cybersecurity audits, compliance assessments, and security reviews.
  • Develop and maintain security documentation, standards, and procedures.

Required Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related field.
  • Preferred Certifications: CCNP, CISSP, CISM, Security+

Experience:

  • 5+ years in enterprise networking and 3+ years in cybersecurity or security engineering.
  • Proven experience designing and supporting Layer 3 networks, multi-site enterprise Wi-Fi, firewalls, and VPNs.
  • Experience supporting multi-site environments, remote users, and secure wireless access.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing or industrial environments, securing OT/IT networks.

Technical Skills:

Networking:

  • Layer 3 networking: OSPF, BGP, VLANs, STP, VRRP/HSRP, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN, and SD-WAN.
  • Multi-site enterprise Wi-Fi design, deployment, and troubleshooting, including Wi-Fi 5/6/6E, site surveys, RF planning, coverage optimization, controllers, access points, guest networks, and security policies.
  • Enterprise wireless platforms (Cisco Meraki/Catalyst, Aruba, Extreme, Ruckus, or Ubiquiti) and secure authentication using WPA2/WPA3 Enterprise, 802.1X, RADIUS, and NAC.

Security:

  • Firewall administration, IDS/IPS, VPN technologies, and Network Access Control (NAC).
  • Security hardening, network segmentation, and endpoint security solutions.

Cybersecurity Platforms:

  • Experience with one or more of, Microsoft Defender Suite, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Tenable, Rapid7, Qualys

Firewall Platforms:

  • Experience with one or more of: Sophos, Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet FortiGate, Cisco Firepower, Check Point, SonicWall

Cloud:

  • Microsoft Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365 Security

Competitive compensation in USD (Dollar Pledge).

Supportive and inclusive work environment.
Career growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding global organization.

This position will be primarily responsible for demonstrated and consistent technical and clinical support to the Clinical Affairs Organization, with specific focus on Electrophysiology (EP) Business Unit (BU) technologies and therapy areas.

This individual will provide field support of clinical research study procedures with Abbott EP BU technologies, as well as accurate technical support/troubleshooting, project and/or territory management, general field image representation for Abbott, and field input to EP BU product management groups. You will function as an expert resource for covering clinical studies/procedures, handling challenging technical/protocol troubleshooting scenarios, critical software or product testing, product or project advisory boards, and high-profile presentations while collaborating with the sites and other cross functional partners on EP BU clinical studies.

This position is field based and remote to candidates located in the Southeastern United States. Candidates must be willing to travel up to 75% during active Clinical Trial Enrollment Periods.

What You’ll Work On

  • Provide field support for clinical research related enrollment and procedures in EP therapy area.

  • Serve as a technology, protocol and clinical trial procedure expert and resource for Abbott stakeholders, physicians, and research personnel at the site.

  • Maintain and develop a productive clinical territory:

  • Develop and maintain knowledge of clinical sites in the assigned territory

  • Manage the following aspects of study progress:

    • Nominate, approach, and complete qualification processes including establishing site/sponsor expectations for study execution.

    • Facilitate contract/budget escalations as part of the start-up process.

    • Train facility staff regarding protocol requirements and technology.

    • Clinical Trial Enrollment

    • Develop site-specific strategies to promote appropriate patient enrollment.

    • Identify site successes and challenges and assist in implementing troubleshooting techniques that promote study goal achievement.

    • Provide ongoing feedback concerning all aspects of study progress, specifically enrollment and procedure related, for the purpose of developing and implementing strategies that will optimize patient safety and contribute to organizational and corporate goals/objectives.

  • Provide support for all study-related aspects to research partners, including but not limited to the following aspects: protocol, standard of care, clinical trial reimbursement, etc.

  • Responsible for product reporting and troubleshooting with customers and field personnel within the EP BU clinical research portfolio

  • Work with territory Clinical Site Leads to share best practices and develop capabilities to optimize trial data quality

  • Collaborate with and provide feedback to Clinical Scientists, study teams, and Clinical Site Leads on study design and procedure and product experiences.

  • Identify and communicate best practices relevant to clinical trial execution.

  • Seek opportunities to continue demonstrating and developing technical, research, and organizational leadership qualities.

  • Collaborate with Clinical Affairs, Medical Affairs, R&D, marketing and commercial teams to support and advance key EP BU projects.

  • Serve as a scientific interface with healthcare professionals.

  • Act as resource in corporate product education as it relates to investigative technologies, as necessary: development and review of training materials, presentations, regional and national product launches, and BU commercial field education.

  • Develop collaborative cross-divisional team relationships.

  • Function as a “pipeline” between Abbott and the medical community, constantly communicating important information to customers, within the Clinical Affairs group and to other departments (product planning, med affairs, engineering, marketing and education). This includes providing product feedback, comments and suggestions and Competitive information to the Product Planning and Marketing groups.

  • Proactively, and with minimal oversight, facilitate sustained strong performance and capabilities of study sites within their territory.

  • Use critical thinking to identify issues, address them, and create plans to augment success or prevent recurrence of variances from site expectations.

  • Work with sites to develop capabilities to take on more complex trials, or larger volume of trials.

  • Communicate to EP BU FCA Management and study team proactively and in a timely manner, all study and site updates critical to clinical priorities.

  • Identify and share best practices for territory management.

  • Deepen area(s) of expertise and function as a regional clinical and technical resource.

  • Utilize effective communication skills in difficult conversations with key stakeholders.

  • Contribute additional value to the organization beyond primary responsibilities which may include but are not limited to:

    • Actively seek opportunities to deliver value on a national level.

    • Serve as a study champion.

    • Provide feedback on product performance.

    • Act as a mentor to other FCS staff.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, biological sciences, a related field, equivalent or related certification in Electrophysiology/Cardiology.

  • 3 or more years of progressively more responsible relevant clinical work experience in the Electrophysiology field.

  • EP Clinical background and field-based experience is preferred.

  • Experience using MS Office Suite.

  • High level of competency in EP Lab procedures.

  • Recognized as a leader and expert beyond local territory

  • Advanced verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization. Exceptional presentation and influence skills.

  • Multitasks, prioritizes and meets deadlines in timely manner.

  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills, as well as attention to detail.

  • Ability to travel up to 75% during active trial enrollment periods.

  • Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs.

  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies; Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or similar certification
  • CAPM or PMP certification (or actively pursuing)
  • Experience supporting SaaS/ERP/CIS technology implementations (e.g., Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, or utility-specific platforms)
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, Smartsheet, or MS Project
  • Experience working within a management consulting environment, including client-facing responsibilities
  • Basic understanding of change management principles (e.g., Prosci/ADKAR).

ABOUT KLED

Kled is building the largest opt-in human data network in the world.

We are not a labeling firm. We are not a task marketplace.

We are a consumer application where people upload their real photos, videos, and documents and get paid continuously.

We then filter, standardize, and license that data to frontier AI labs and enterprises that need fresh, rights-aware training data.

Since launching our mobile app in 2026, we have:

• Reached #1 on the App Store (Finance) with 0 paid marketing
• Scaled to 600,000+ active data contributors

• Processed 5M uploads per day

• Raised $15M+ from investors behind SpaceX, Airbnb, Coinbase, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Spotify, Lyft, Uber, and more

Our mission is to let anyone download the app and earn a real living wage from uploading their data.

This listing is for one paid task in the Kled app: "Government Service Websites". There is no interview and no minimum hours: download the app, open the task, and you are paid per accepted submission.

What you will do

Screenshot a government or public service website. Public pages only, nothing from your own account.

Steps

  1. Open a government or public service site

  2. Navigate to a public information or form screen

  3. Check no personal data is on screen

  4. Screenshot the full page

  5. Upload

What gets rejected

  • Never your own account pages with your data

  • Do not log in and screenshot personal records

  • Do not crop the page header

Accepted: Public-facing government service screen; no personal account data visible; full screen.

Pay

$1.10 per accepted screenshot. At a typical pace of about 2 minutes per screenshot, that is about $33 per hour. A 20-minute session of about 10 screenshots pays about $11.00. Up to 50 screenshots per upload. You are paid per accepted submission (piecework, independent contractor); submissions that break the rules are not paid. Payouts are made in the app (PayPal, Venmo or a Solana wallet).

Where and when

Open in 11 Southeast Asian countries, including Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam. Remote, on your own schedule. Independent contractor, piecework; this is not an employment position.

What you need

  • An iPhone running iOS 18.6 or later (the Kled app is iPhone-only right now)

  • 18 or older

  • Screenshots taken on your own phone

How to start

  1. Download Kled from the App Store: (also at kled.ai/app).

  2. Create your account and open Tasks.

  3. Search "Government Service Websites", read the brief and follow the on-screen steps.

  4. Submit. Accepted submissions are paid in the app.

Every submission is reviewed, and you opt in to a commercial training license on each upload; accepted submissions are licensed to AI labs. Questions: .

Columbus Radiology Corporation (CRC) and Radiology Associates of Canton (RAC) are seeking full-time remote general and neuroradiologists to support our growing practice throughout the state of Ohio.

CRC and RAC are seeking a Board-Eligible or Board-Certified General Radiologist or Neuro Radiologist to join our remote evening team.   • Comfortable with all modalities within subspecialty

Physician Owned. Physician Led. Founded in 1946, Columbus Radiology Corporation is the fifth largest and one of the fastest growing practices in the country, now with 180+ board-certified and subspecialty trained radiologists who are committed to excellence – in patient care, physician relations, continuous quality improvement and professional development. CRC is committed perpetual improvement through new clinical initiatives, research, artificial intelligence, and best practices that provide proven value to patients and payors. This clinical team is an extension of our Radiologists, which helps in reducing day to day administrative minutiae. The Advisory Board Company and the American College of Radiology have both recognized this as an innovative customer service function.

WE ARE ALWAYS LOOKING FOR GREAT TALENT TO JOIN OUR TEAM. IF THIS POSITION IS NOT PERFECT FOR YOU, PLEASE CONTACT US DIRECTLY AND LET US TAILOR A POSITION THAT IS!

In addition to this range, Radiology Partners offers competitive total rewards packages, which include health & wellness coverage options, 401k benefits, and a broad range of other benefits such as family planning and telehealth (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements).

RADIOLOGY PARTNERS OVERVIEW

As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, we advance our bold mission by innovating across clinical value, technology, service, and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare. Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and referring physicians we serve.

title: Finance Engineer
description: SPRCHRGR (pronounced "supercharger") is a professional services consultancy providing highly skilled team members across a variety of complementary disciplines.

raw.title: Finance Engineer
raw.excerpt: SPRCHRGR (pronounced "supercharger") is a professional services consultancy providing highly skilled team members across a variety of complementary disciplines.
raw.description:
SPRCHRGR (pronounced "supercharger") is a professional services consultancy providing highly skilled team members across a variety of complementary disciplines. We like to say, “cut out the vowels, get there faster!” because we prioritize creativity, efficiency, and performance in our work, and we have fun doing it.

Our exceptional staff + innovative approach set us apart from stuffy traditional accountancies and commoditized outsourced bookkeeping agencies. We think differently about our work supporting high-growth startups, forward-thinking SMBs, and nonprofits located all across the US.

We specialize in cutting-edge technology and partner with dynamic businesses across diverse industries. Our team culture emphasizes collaboration, learning, and process-driven efficiency.

We're looking for someone who reads a trial balance and writes software. You'll build the client-facing financial tools for our fractional CFO firm: interactive dashboards and forecasting models, AI assistants that answer finance questions from live accounting data, and automations that take real recurring work off our clients' plates. We're small, we move fast, and we build our own tools instead of buying and configuring someone else's platform.

Who we are

SPRCHRGR combines executive financial leadership, fractional CFO work and controllership with data, systems integration and workflow automation. Our clients run $1 million to $50 million in revenue and get a white-glove build, not a template. We're small, we move fast, and we build our own tools (when it makes sense) instead of buying and configuring someone else's platform.

What you'll do

  • Build and own our client dashboards. Interactive financial models delivered as web apps, with scenario sliders, drill-down tables, and Excel exports a client's own finance lead can audit.
  • Build AI automations. Small, versioned automations that do one job properly, like turning a client's billing spreadsheet into reconciled QuickBooks invoices with built-in approval gates.
  • Get the data in yourself. Write the database queries behind our reporting and connect them to live client accounting data. Our VP of Technology owns the platform and will hand you the tools and procedures to work independently, not a ticket queue.
  • Be the person we trust when two numbers disagree. Work discrepancies to a documented answer, and know a genuine variance from two figures that were never comparable.
  • Teach the rest of us. Help our accountants and operators build their own tools instead of depending on you for every one.
  • Work directly with clients. Meet (virtually) with key client stakeholders to work out what they need, then build it. No layer in between, although you'll have full access to collaborate with other accounting + finance experts within our firm.

Who you are

You have both halves. Finance + Engineering.

  • Finance: real depth in accounting, financial statements, month-end close, receivables and payables, reconciliation, how a general ledger actually works. CPA or CMA is a strong signal; demonstrated judgment matters more.
  • Building: you write and maintain real code and real database queries. Our VP of Engineering partners with you to architect, maintain, and enhance the secure data warehouses, APIs, and hosted web app platform underneath. You can take a system with wrong or missing documentation, work out what it actually does, and build against reality. You've built AI tools, not just used them.

Minimum requirements

  • Bachelor's degree with a focus in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of combined experience across accounting or finance and software or systems development.
  • CPA or CMA preferred, not required.
  • Proficiency in SQL preferred, not required.
  • Experience with at least one accounting system in depth, such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or Dynamics.
  • Clear and concise communication, both written and verbal.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment.
  • A dedicated workspace and access to reliable, secure, high-speed internet.
  • An unwavering commitment to confidentiality.
  • Based in the United States
  • Embrace SPRCHRGR's Core Values.

What this job isn't

  • Not a reporting role. If you just want to produce monthly financial packages, this is the wrong job.
  • Not a coordinator between finance and engineering. You build.
  • Not a management role in year one.
  • Not a place to learn accounting on the job.

Compensation and benefits

  • Fully Remote: Work from home with a structured schedule.
  • Career Growth: Gain hands-on mentoring and opportunities to work directly with our Founder & CEO.
  • Team-Oriented Environment: Collaborate with Software Engineers, Sr. Controllers, CFOs, and Accounting Managers to synthesize bespoke solutions for our clients.
  • Competitive pay: $150,000 - $180,000 Base Salary, DOE.
  • Phantom Equity: Eligible for consideration after your first year.
  • Bonus: Annual performance-based bonus compensation plan.
  • 401k: Up to a 4% match and no vesting period.
  • Benefits: Customizable options.

What will make you stand out

Send us something you built: a repository, a working file, or a written account of an automation you shipped end to end, with the before-and-after time it took. That matters more to us than a cover letter. If your best example is client work you can't share, tell us what it did and how you'd rebuild it!

Application Notice

At SPRCHRGR, we value fairness, clarity, and attention to detail in our hiring process. To ensure an equitable process, we ask that you submit your application only through the official posting for this role.

  • Do not contact our hiring managers, team members, or leadership directly (via personal email, LinkedIn, or other channels). Applications received in this way will be automatically disqualified. Please direct all questions and inquiries to

Notice to External Recruiters
Please do not send unsolicited candidate submissions to our team. Our system automatically blocks domains that repeatedly send unrequested outreach.

WHO WE ARE

Ethical

We do good. We act with integrity, earning trust instead of asking for it, and we do what is right even when it isn’t easy. We are transparent, promptly sharing information and feedback directly and freely with all relevant stakeholders.

Positive

We love what we do. It shows in the positive and constructive attitude we bring every day. We realize work is more than just output; it’s about the life experiences we share along the way.

Passionate

We care. A lot. We expect high performance of ourselves and our teammates. We constantly look to innovate and improve. We play to win and keep raising the bar to deliver results.

Professional

We are one team, focused on the "we" rather than the "I." We’re consistently organized and accountable. Our work speaks for itself and stands the test of time.

Inclusive

By design, our team members believe, act, feel, and look differently from each other. We foster a sense of belonging and respect for every individual and we expect the same from our clients and partners.

HOW WE OPERATE

We focus on what matters

We work efficiently but don't cut corners or compromise on best practices. We prioritize long-term value over short-term gains. We value simplicity over complexity.

We reward it

We reward the effort of our peers with matched enthusiasm. We share the spotlight and credit generously. We celebrate our successes, even the small ones.

We own it

We take pride in our work. We see projects through from start to finish. We continuously update process documentation and fix things we find broken along the way.

We’re a service-first organization

We exemplify a customer-first mindset across everything we do internally & externally, always learning from our colleagues, partners, and clients. While the customer isn’t always right, we value their trust in us and strive to reciprocate value by anticipating their needs, priorities, and expectations.

raw.description:
ABOUT KLED

Kled is building the largest opt-in human data network in the world.

We are not a labeling firm. We are not a task marketplace.

We are a consumer application where people upload their real photos, videos, and documents and get paid continuously.

We then filter, standardize, and license that data to frontier AI labs and enterprises that need fresh, rights-aware training data.

Since launching our mobile app in 2026, we have:

• Reached #1 on the App Store (Finance) with 0 paid marketing
• Scaled to 600,000+ active data contributors

• Processed 5M uploads per day

• Raised $15M+ from investors behind SpaceX, Airbnb, Coinbase, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Spotify, Lyft, Uber, and more

Our mission is to let anyone download the app and earn a real living wage from uploading their data.

This listing is for one paid task in the Kled app: "Fine-Grained Similar Objects". There is no interview and no minimum hours: download the app, open the task, and you are paid per accepted submission.

What you will do

Photograph three or more things that look almost the same, then tell us what's different about them.

Steps

  1. Gather three or more similar items that differ subtly

  2. Arrange them in one frame

  3. Photograph close enough to see the differences

  4. Say what distinguishes them

  5. Upload

What gets rejected

  • Do not use obviously different objects

  • Do not use fewer than three

  • Do not shoot too far away to see detail

Accepted: Three or more genuinely similar variants in one frame with the distinguishing feature named.

Pay

$0.65 per accepted photo. At a typical pace of about 2.5 minutes per photo, that is about $16 per hour. A 20-minute session of about 8 photos pays about $5.20. Up to 10 photos per upload. You are paid per accepted submission (piecework, independent contractor); submissions that break the rules are not paid. Payouts are made in the app (PayPal, Venmo or a Solana wallet).

Where and when

Open worldwide: the task runs in 100+ countries. Remote, on your own schedule. Independent contractor, piecework; this is not an employment position.

What you need

  • An iPhone running iOS 18.6 or later (the Kled app is iPhone-only right now)

  • 18 or older

  • Your own writing, typed in the app

How to start

  1. Download Kled from the App Store: (also at kled.ai/app).

  2. Create your account and open Tasks.

  3. Search "Fine-Grained Similar Objects", read the brief and follow the on-screen steps.

  4. Submit. Accepted submissions are paid in the app.

Every submission is reviewed, and you opt in to a commercial training license on each upload; accepted submissions are licensed to AI labs. Questions: .

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Paraplanner/Admin & Operations Specialist

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: A modern financial advisory firm that provides tailored financial advice to help clients make confident, long-term decisions. Operating as a collaborative team, it combines technical expertise with a thoughtful, client-first approach. The business is built on trust, transparency, and consistency in delivering high-quality advice. As the business grows, it continues to strengthen and grow its team in order to maintain its service offering precision and reliability.

Role Overview: The Paraplanner/Admin & Operations Specialist is responsible for the preparation of ongoing review documents, Statements of Advice (SOAs), Records of Advice (ROAs), and related technical research. In keeping with the company’s philosophy that every piece of advice should be intelligent, considered and personalized, this role also provides essential client administration support to ensure seamless, high-quality day-to-day operations that reflect the standard of the brand.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Paraplanning & Advice Document Preparation

  • Use AI tools to generate, structure, and refine Statements of Advice (SOAs) and Records of Advice (ROAs) in accordance with Australian regulatory requirements and best practice standards
  • Apply critical review skills to AI-generated advice documents, checking for accuracy, compliance, suitability, and client-specific relevance before adviser sign-off
  • Conduct investment, insurance, superannuation, and strategic research to inform and quality-check advice content
  • Prepare annual review documents, portfolio reports, and client review packs using workflows
  • Analyse client financial data to model scenarios and projections in support of advice strategy
  • Ensure all advice documents comply with relevant compliance frameworks, including AFSL requirements and the Best Interests Duty
  • Liaise with the adviser to refine advice strategies and ensure accurate reflection of client goals and circumstances
  • Maintain and update document templates to ensure consistency and efficiency

2. Ongoing Client Review Support

  • Coordinate and prepare for scheduled annual and semi-annual client reviews
  • Compile pre-meeting packs including portfolio valuations, asset allocations, and fee disclosure documents
  • Update client records and financial data in the CRM/practice management system following review meetings and as work is conducted throughout the year
  • Track review schedules and follow up on outstanding client actions post-meeting

3. Client Administration & Office Support

  • Handle client onboarding administration including data collection, file setup, and ID verification
  • Process new business applications, rollovers, and product instructions with fund managers, insurers, and super funds
  • Correspond with clients, product providers, and third parties via email and phone in a professional and timely manner
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client files and records within the practice management system
  • Prepare Fee Disclosure Statements (FDS) and Opt-In notices as required
  • Assist with compliance documentation, file notes, and audit trail maintenance
  • Support invoicing, fee collection, and general office administration as required

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of paraplanning experience within an Australian financial planning practice
  • Demonstrated experience preparing SOAs and ROAs across investment, superannuation, insurance, and retirement planning
  • Solid working knowledge of the Australian financial planning regulatory environment (Corporations Act, FASEA, Best Interests Duty)
  • Proficiency using AI-powered tools and platforms to draft, refine, and quality-check Statements of Advice and related documents
  • Comfort working with large language models (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, or specialist financial planning AI tools) as part of an advice production workflow
  • Strong written English communication skills with the ability to produce clear, professional client-facing documents
  • High attention to detail with strong organisational and time management skills
  • Experience working remotely with Australian financial planning or professional services firms
  • Valid NBI/Police Clearance

Desirable:

  • Diploma of Financial Planning (FNS50622) or equivalent Australian qualification, or currently studying towards it
  • Knowledge of Australian products including managed funds, platforms (e.g. Netwealth, HUB24, Macquarie Wrap), and life insurance
  • Experience using AI writing or document generation tools in a professional or financial services context
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering or working effectively with large language models to produce structured, compliant outputs
  • Experience with portfolio reporting tools and CRM/practice management systems Understanding of aged care advice, SMSFs, or estate planning as supplementary areas

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

At Wipfli, people count

At Wipfli, our people are core to everything we do—the catalyst behind our ability to create exceptional impact and extraordinary results.

People truly matter and they feel it. For those looking to make a difference and find a professional home, Wipfli offers a career-defining opportunity.

Wipfli’s Outsourced Accounting practice is seeking a Senior Manager with deep nonprofit expertise to provide CFO‑level advisory and lead mission‑critical client engagements. In this role, you will deliver strategic financial insights, guide nonprofit leaders through budgeting, forecasting, and operational transformation, and oversee multiple teams to ensure exceptional quality and clarity in all deliverables. You’ll act as a trusted, perceptive advisor to executive teams, helping organizations strengthen financial health and advance their mission. Rooted in the Wipfli Way, this role offers the opportunity to make a lasting impact while contributing to a collaborative, people‑first culture that values curiosity, excellence, and meaningful client relationships.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

  • Lead client advisory engagements at a CFO-level, delivering strategic financial insights and operational guidance.
  • Drive change management initiatives to modernize service delivery through technology, standardized processes, and best practices.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with client executives by understanding their business goals and delivering tailored solutions.
  • Oversee multiple client teams, ensuring timely and accurate completion of accounting engagements.
  • Analyze financial performance, including KPIs, and provide actionable recommendations to improve profitability and cash flow.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams (e.g., revenue cycle, payroll, cost reporting) to deliver integrated client solutions.
  • Develop client budgets and forecasts, offering consultative support on financial planning and strategy.
  • Mentor and develop staff, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; Master’s degree a plus.

  • Strong communication skills to translate complex financial and compliance topics into clear, practical guidance for non‑financial stakeholders and Boards.
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant Public Accounting or industry accounting experience.
  • Proven success leading teams through organizational change and process improvement.
  • Strong project management and relationship-building skills, with a client-first mindset.
  • Experience managing remote teams and promoting collaboration across geographies.
  • Preferred proficiency in industry accounting software, e.g., QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, and a demonstrated ability to embrace new technologies.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%

Christine Villicana from Wipfli’s recruiting team will be guiding you through this process.  Visit her LinkedIn Page to connect!

raw.description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

Armada is seeking a Physical Security – Facilities Lead to own classified design, construction, and accreditation of Galleons for the U.S. Defense sector.

Galleons are built, configured, shipped, and stood up in months, not years. Defense customers need those units accredited as SCIFs, SAPFs, collateral open-storage or closed areas, and related secure processing environments. You will turn ICD 705, DoDM 5205.07, and NISPOM (32 CFR Part 117) physical construction standards into repeatable design requirements, factory and site practices, and accreditation packages that scale with the product line.

You will be the company authority on physical security for secure builds. You will sit with hardware, form-factor, manufacturing, deployment, federal, and security partners from concept through accreditation of the space. Where corporate facility protection overlaps a secure build, you will also set access control, intrusion detection, CPTED, and guard-force requirements as applicable. Corporate physical security is not a separate program. It is in scope only where it touches classified design, construction, or accreditation.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role. You will write the standard, walk the line, brief the Accrediting Official, and close the findings. You will exercise independent judgment on problems without precedent, be accountable for results across Armada's secure-build function, and direct the work of contractors, integrators, and cross-functional partners without having direct reports.

Location. United States (Remote). Travel to U.S. factory, integration, and customer sites as needed to support design reviews, construction surveillance, and accreditation.

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Classified design and construction standards

  • Own physical construction and accreditation requirements for defense Galleons, including SCIFs and SAPFs under ICD 705 and the ICS 705 Technical Specifications, SAPFs under DoDM 5205.07, and collateral open-storage, closed, and discussion areas under 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM).
  • Translate those standards into design criteria, drawing notes, BOM constraints, and factory work instructions that hardware, mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing teams can build to.
  • Lead security design reviews across the Galleon family. Read and redline architectural, structural, electrical, and low-voltage drawings against ICD 705, TEMPEST, and NISPOM.
  • Define perimeter, access-control, intrusion-detection, and video requirements for secure configurations, including door, lock, and wall assemblies, STC and acoustic performance, and inspectable materials.
  • Own TEMPEST and emissions-security design input. Set red/black separation, shielding, filtering, grounding, and penetration criteria, and coordinate countermeasure reviews with customer TEMPEST authorities.
  • Specify Protected Distribution Systems where a Galleon or site requires them and inspect against the applicable CNSSI standard.
  • Build a repeatable secure-Galleon configuration so accreditation is a productized path, not a one-off for every build.

Accreditation and government liaison

  • Serve as Armada’s liaison to Accrediting Officials, Special Security Officers, Facility Security Officers, DCSA Industrial Security Representatives, and customer security staff.
  • Author and maintain Construction Security Plans, Fixed Facility Checklists, inspectable-materials lists, TEMPEST questionnaires, and accreditation submittals.
  • Plan and run construction surveillance, site inspections, and quality assurance on factory, integration, and customer-site work. Hold general contractors, integrators, and internal build teams to the CSP.
  • Drive accreditation from design approval through inspection, remediation, and operational accreditation. Own the punch list.
  • Support capture and proposal teams on DD-254, contract security classification specifications, and physical-security volumes so bids do not promise a configuration that cannot be accredited.

Program execution

  • Own the security workstream on defense Galleon programs. Set milestones, dependencies, and risks against hardware design, factory slot, shipment, and customer required-accreditation dates.
  • Partner with Large Form Factor and Edge Hardware leads, deployment, logistics, and federal mission teams so security requirements are in the design before steel is cut.
  • Stand up the operating rhythm for classified builds: design gates, inspection hold points, documentation control, and lessons learned into the next hull.
  • Author and maintain Armada's internal physical-security policies and standards for classified builds, and mentor engineering, manufacturing, and deployment teams so secure-build expertise scales across the company.

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship.
  • Active U.S. Secret clearance required.
  • Bachelor's degree and 12+ years (or Master's degree and 8+ years) in physical security, industrial security, or secure-facility construction, with at least 5 years hands-on in design, build, and accreditation of SCIFs, SAPFs, or collateral open-storage areas.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply ICD 705 Technical Specifications to construction drawings and field conditions, not just cite them.
  • Working knowledge of 32 CFR Part 117 physical safeguards and of DoDM 5205.07 as it applies to SAPF construction and accreditation.
  • Experience as the technical interface to an Accrediting Official, Cognizant Security Office, or DCSA representative through accreditation.
  • Experience authoring Construction Security Plans and fixed-facility or equivalent accreditation packages.
  • Ability to read construction documents and reject noncompliant details on walls, doors, penetrations, power, grounding, and electronic security systems.
  • Experience with access control, intrusion detection, and alarm monitoring on accredited spaces (UL 2050 or equivalent).
  • Track record of driving a build to a date with engineers, contractors, and government security staff in the same room.
  • Recognized subject-matter expert who has set physical-security standards or policy for an organization and persuaded diverse senior internal and government stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in Business Systems, Enterprise Applications, or related roles with increasing scope.
  • Platform-agnostic technical fluency in how enterprise systems work: relational database structures, data flows, API and webhook integration patterns, static vs. dynamic configuration, and how upstream changes propagate downstream. The right candidate can describe any enterprise system — regardless of whether they’ve used it before — in terms of its underlying data model and CRUD operations.
  • Ability to read (not necessarily write) JavaScript and Apex code: you need to understand what custom logic is doing and assess compatibility with proposed changes, not just know it exists.
  • Demonstrated experience owning and scaling core systems for G&A and/or Finance functions.
  • Solid integration and data fluency: APIs, iPaaS tools (e.g., Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft), data quality concepts, and reporting infrastructure.
  • Strong change management instincts: you bring stakeholders along, drive adoption, and create durable operating habits.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management — able to translate between business outcomes and technical implementation, facilitate cross-functional trade-off conversations, and influence without authority.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for and working knowledge of AI/LLM tooling — and a track record of helping teams actually adopt new tools, not just deploy them.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or implementing enterprise AI enablement programs (tool stack, training, workflow redesign).
  • Familiarity with GTM tooling (CRM, CPQ, forecasting) and/or R&D/engineering systems at a level sufficient to establish standards and ensure interoperability.
  • Experience with revenue workflows and controls (billing, collections, revenue recognition concepts).
  • Comfort prototyping or validating logic using SQL and/or scripting, or deep partnership with technical teams to do so.
  • Experience implementing security and compliance controls across business systems (audit readiness, access governance).
  • Relevant certifications (nice-to-have): NetSuite, Workday, Rippling, iPaaS platform certs.

Citizenship Requirements

For select roles, due to the nature of our clientele and the technologies involved, there may be specific nationality or citizenship indicated in the required qualifications section. These roles may involve access to sensitive information that is subject to export control regulations or other legal restrictions. In such cases, employment offers will be contingent upon your ability to comply with these requirements.

Compensation & Benefits

For U.S. Based candidates: To ensure fairness and transparency, the starting base salary range for this role for candidates in the U.S. are listed, varying based on location experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits (details available upon request).

We use a geographic pay structure based on cost-of-labor markets.

  • Tier 1 (e.g., SF Bay Area, NYC, Seattle): $187,500 - $234,370
  • Tier 2 (most U.S. metro areas): $163,040 - $203,800
  • Tier 3 (other cities): $154,890 - $193,610

Final compensation will be determined by experience, scope, and level, and may vary from the posted range.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary and equity
  • Medical, dental, and vision (subsidized cost)
  • Health savings accounts (HSA), flexible spending accounts (FSA), and dependent care FSAs (DCFSA)
  • Retirement plan options, including 401(k) and Roth 401(k)
  • Unlimited paid time off (PTO)
  • 14 paid company holidays per year
Compensation
$163,040—$203,800 USD

You're a Great Fit if You're

  • A go-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge
  • A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company
  • A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda
  • Highly organized and results-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Armada, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone is given equal opportunities to thrive. As an equal opportunity employer, we strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment based on race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, and compensation. Our hiring is guided by qualifications, merit, and the business needs at the time.

raw.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

At NVIDIA, as a Principal Rack Scale Systems Infrastructure Engineer, you will build and guide the development of software systems. These systems support our upcoming rack-scale infrastructure products and services. This exceptional role sits where software meets hardware. You will work on control planes, state machines, orchestration systems, firmware, OS lifecycle, and networking fabrics. Your task is to compose infrastructure-as-a-service control plane software that converts complex rack-scale hardware into dependable, manageable, and programmable infrastructure for NVIDIA, partners, and leading cloud and enterprise clients globally.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Define the complete software architecture for rack-scale infrastructure products and services, covering control plane services, infrastructure management, firmware, operating systems, kernel drivers, networking fabrics, accelerator software, and user-mode manageability software.

  • Use Kubernetes and cloud-native primitives as an infrastructure fabric when appropriate. This includes controllers, operators, reconciliation loops, and open source components. These components can operate safely at rack and fleet scale. Build open source infrastructure software that can be embraced in different forms, including libraries, services, controllers, operators, and integration APIs for internal deployments and CSP environments.

  • Bridge hardware and software teams across firmware, BMC, BIOS, boot flows, OS images, drivers, networking, NVLink domains, InfiniBand, GPUs, DPUs, CPUs, and system management interfaces. Translate forward-looking infrastructure roadmaps into formal software requirements, architecture specifications, and execution plans that align teams across the organization.

  • Partner directly with hyperscalers, CSPs, enterprise customers, internal component leads, vendors, and business partners to align infrastructure capabilities with real-world deployment and integration needs. Establish reliability, security, validation, and left-shift strategies that reduce risk before hardware reaches production environments.

  • Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, raising the engineering bar for large-scale networked systems, foundational software, and rack-scale control plane development.

  • Make high-quality technical decisions in ambiguous environments, balancing customer needs, schedule, hardware realities, software maintainability, open source adoption, and long-term infrastructure evolution.

What We Need To See:

  • BS or MS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Proven experience (15+ years) in systems architecture, system software, distributed systems, infrastructure control planes, or infrastructure engineering.

  • Solid architectural knowledge of coordination frameworks, state machines, declarative APIs, reconciliation loops, lifecycle orchestration, failure handling, upgrade and rollback workflows, and distributed systems tradeoffs.

  • Practical coding skills in Go, C++, or Rust, encompassing the capability to write, review, and direct production-quality infrastructure software. Experience with Rust is highly valued.

  • Experience with Kubernetes or similar orchestration systems, especially as a fabric for managing infrastructure, hardware resources, or large-scale infrastructure services. Experience with Linux-based infrastructure software, OS rollout and image management, kernel or driver interactions, firmware lifecycle, and hardware bring-up workflows.

  • Strong understanding of data center networking technologies and protocols, such as Ethernet, InfiniBand, RDMA, and fabric-level manageability. Experience with complex accelerator-based systems, including GPUs, DPUs, FPGAs, custom silicon, or other high-performance computing systems.

  • Expertise in in-band and out-of-band management architectures, including BMCs, Redfish, IPMI, and related system management protocols. Ability to work with security experts to define practical tradeoffs across secure boot, attestation, access control, update safety, serviceability, and ease of operation.

  • Experience crafting software intended for open source release, including API stability, modularity, documentation, community usability, and clean separation between shared software and deployment-specific integrations.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools responsibly as an engineering multiplier for coding, test generation, debugging, build iteration, and documentation.

  • Established skill in specifying requirements, guiding architecture, and managing delivery across various engineering teams and organizations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, enabling clear explanation of complex hardware/software tradeoffs to engineering leaders, customers, partners, and executives.

Ways To Stand Out from the crowd:

  • Built software supporting multiple adoption models — internal services, CSP-integrated offerings, reusable libraries, and customer-extensible APIs. Strong Rust skills in systems, infrastructure, or hardware-adjacent software.

  • Multiplied team impact through reference implementations, design reviews, shared libraries, architecture docs, dev workflows, and AI-assisted engineering. Hands-on with fleet-scale provisioning, updates, rollback, observability, health, and remediation.

  • Led across the full data center product lifecycle: inception, pre- and post-silicon, manufacturing, deployment, and operations. Familiar with open source ecosystems, contribution models, and balancing community collaboration with product needs.

  • Deep experience with rack- or cluster-scale systems spanning compute, networking, storage, accelerators, firmware, and infra management as one operational domain. Skilled at finding simple, durable abstractions in complex systems to align teams, customers, and long-term direction.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff Product Manager, where you'll shape the next generation of identity products.

About the job

As a Staff Product Manager you will help scale Twilio’s core identity product delivering secure, developer-first identity experiences. You’ll build products that power authentication, authorization, and emerging agentic and non-human identity use cases. You’ll partner closely with product and engineering leadership to design and deliver high-impact customer-facing features. This is a rare chance to operate like a startup within Twilio: you’ll work in a high-ownership environment with startup speed, backed by Twilio’s reach and scale.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Design product capabilities for Identity platform on Twilio—building new products that help our customers’ secure their applications for both agentic and human identity use cases.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to set direction, translate customer needs into product capabilities, and build the roadmap to deliver on these capabilities.
  • Collaborate across Twilio teams to align on product direction and unblock cross-team initiatives.
  • Operate with deep product ownership: author PRFAQs, product requirement docs, collaborate closely with engineering and design to bring these ideas to life, and enable our go-to-market teams to help our customs solve their challenges leveraging our products.
  • Build in ambiguity—break down complex problems, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and design developer experiences that delight our customers.
  • Be the voice of the customer in every conversation and decision, and ensure we build world class products that our customers value.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 5+ years experience in product management or 2+ years in product management and 3+ years in an engineering role
  • Experience in building deeply technical products and/or products for developers.
  • Bachelor in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience required.
  • Strong technical, analytical, and UI/UX design understanding.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Desired:

  • Experience in identity and access management.
  • Experience building developer tools or SDKs
  • Builder at heart. Through a hobby or your profession, you are passionate about being hands on and seeing your work come to life.

Location

This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C : $155,520 -$194,400.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $164,640 - $205,800
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $182,960 - $228,700
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until December 31, 2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. raw.description:
ABOUT KLED

Kled is building the largest opt-in human data network in the world.

We are not a labeling firm. We are not a task marketplace.

We are a consumer application where people upload their real photos, videos, and documents and get paid continuously.

We then filter, standardize, and license that data to frontier AI labs and enterprises that need fresh, rights-aware training data.

Since launching our mobile app in 2026, we have:

• Reached #1 on the App Store (Finance) with 0 paid marketing
• Scaled to 600,000+ active data contributors

• Processed 5M uploads per day

• Raised $15M+ from investors behind SpaceX, Airbnb, Coinbase, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Spotify, Lyft, Uber, and more

Our mission is to let anyone download the app and earn a real living wage from uploading their data.

This listing is for one paid task in the Kled app: "Upload Anything". There is no interview and no minimum hours: download the app, open the task, and you are paid per accepted submission.

What you will do

Send us photos from your phone. Anything you're happy to share, food, places, pets, your street.

Steps

  1. Tap Choose files

  2. Select any photos you are happy to share

  3. Check nothing private is visible

  4. Tap Upload

What gets rejected

  • No screenshots of other photos

  • No images downloaded from the internet

  • No sending the same photo twice

Accepted: Real photo from a real camera. 512px minimum short edge. Not a duplicate of one you already sent.

Pay

$0.02 per accepted photo. At a typical pace of about 6 seconds per photo, that is about $12 per hour. A 20-minute session of about 200 photos pays about $4.00. Up to 100 photos per upload. You are paid per accepted submission (piecework, independent contractor); submissions that break the rules are not paid. Payouts are made in the app (PayPal, Venmo or a Solana wallet).

Where and when

Open worldwide: the task runs in 100+ countries. Remote, on your own schedule. Independent contractor, piecework; this is not an employment position.

What you need

  • An iPhone running iOS 18.6 or later (the Kled app is iPhone-only right now)

  • 18 or older

  • Photos you took yourself, on your own phone

How to start

  1. Download Kled from the App Store: (also at kled.ai/app).

  2. Create your account and open Tasks.

  3. Search "Upload Anything", read the brief and follow the on-screen steps.

  4. Submit. Accepted submissions are paid in the app.

Every submission is reviewed, and you opt in to a commercial training license on each upload; accepted submissions are licensed to AI labs. Questions: .

About the company

Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We were the first company to tokenize exposure to US Treasuries, and have since expanded into several other assets. We are also focused on incubating protocols that can support both tokenized real-world assets and traditional crypto.

Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the Role

We're looking for a Compliance Manager to lead and strengthen our monitoring and investigations program across both fiat and on-chain activity. You'll own transaction monitoring, secondary market and trade surveillance, investigations, and regulatory reporting, and you'll be a key partner to Legal, Product, Engineering, and Operations as we scale.

This role suits a hands-on investigator who's equally comfortable tracing funds through a blockchain explorer, analyzing trading patterns for manipulation, and writing a SAR narrative that holds up to regulatory scrutiny.

Responsibilities

  • Own the day-to-day transaction monitoring program for fiat and digital asset flows, including alert review, escalation, and disposition.
  • Design, tune, and document monitoring rules and scenarios based on the firm's risk assessment, typologies, and emerging threats.
  • Use blockchain analytics tools to assess wallet exposure, counterparty risk, and illicit-finance indicators such as sanctions, mixers, darknet markets, scams, and ransomware.
  • Track alert volumes, false-positive rates, and SLAs, and drive improvements in efficiency and coverage.
  • Build and run surveillance for trading activity on primary and secondary markets, including on-chain transfers, DEX/CEX activity, and OTC flows.
  • Detect and investigate potential market abuse, including wash trading, spoofing, layering, front-running, pump-and-dump schemes, and insider trading.
  • Work with Engineering and Data teams on surveillance tooling, data pipelines, and alert logic.
  • Maintain reporting procedures, quality control checks, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Support regulatory exams, independent audits, and responses to regulator inquiries.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in financial crimes compliance, with significant hands-on work in investigations, AML/BSA, and transaction monitoring.
  • Demonstrated experience with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis (Reactor, KYT), TRM Labs, or Elliptic, and the ability to trace funds independently on-chain.
  • Strong working knowledge of the BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, FinCEN guidance, and OFAC sanctions requirements.
  • A track record of writing high-quality SAR narratives and investigation reports.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work with large datasets and spot anomalous patterns.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, sound judgment, and the ability to handle sensitive matters with discretion.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with trade surveillance or market abuse detection at a broker-dealer, exchange, ATS, or digital asset trading venue.
  • Familiarity with securities regulations (SEC, FINRA) and how they apply to tokenized assets or digital securities.
  • Experience building or scaling a monitoring program at a high-growth fintech or crypto company.
  • Experience managing or mentoring analysts.
  • Certifications such as CAMS, CCAS, CFE, or CCI.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation including but not limited to salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — We are well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation.
  • Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO).
  • Remote-first team across many countries — You will be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices.
  • A+ colleagues — Our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap.
  • Best-in-class investors — We are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures.

Bank, Men’s Wearhouse and Tux, and K&G Fashion.Our Canadian stores are operated under the brand name of Moores in ten provinces. Our purpose is we help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments. We accomplish this by putting customers at the center of every decision, rallying together to achieve common goals, and striving for excellence and continuous improvement. We help fulfill this purpose by valuing differences and knowing they make us better and showing up with courage to always do the right thing. If you want to make a difference, be part of a great team and grow, you might be a perfect fit.

About the Job

We currently have an exciting remote opportunity for a Test & Learn Analystto join the Tailored Brands Enterprise Analytics team. The Enterprise Analytics team is central to our data-forward strategy, driving insights into every aspect of our business, supporting stakeholders across the organization, and creating a legendary customer experience. The Test & Learn Analyst will partner closely with stakeholders across our business – designing test experiments to answer key business questions, analyzing data, and providing insights that help improve business strategies and decision-making processes. You will leverage your skills in stakeholder management, data processing and storytelling, to ensure quality analytical work that is impactful to business outcomes. You’ll coordinate with senior leadership to understand what’s working, what we should change, and make tradeoffs between tactics.
Tailored Brands is a high-growth, collaborative environment where people who are comfortable with ambiguity and have an investigative mindset will thrive. If you love technology, have a grasp of the big picture, and communicate equally well with software engineers and business stakeholders, we are looking for you!

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities

  • Partner with business stakeholders on key business questions, delivering creative test solutions and strategies to drive real business results.
  • Provide actionable test results in a clear, interpretable, and applicable way that can be shared widely, communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.
  • Conduct ad-hoc analyses to identify test opportunities and goals.
  • Participate in test planning meetings, offering counsel and recommendations on best practices for test design while also adjusting for business needs.
  • Manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously based on what is most impactful to the business and our customers
  • Act as liaison between Test & Learn vendor and internal IT identifying relevant store/customer attributes and metrics to set up as data feeds and assisting internal IT with data maintenance and validation.
  • Partner across Analytics to share learnings, align on methodologies and leverage best practices.

What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in analytics, with progressive responsibility in leading, executing, and presenting data-driven projects to cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Mastercard's Test & Learn tool (Previously APT), with deep hands-on experience in utilizing it for test analysis, optimization, and decision-making processes.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing process to improve business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify business needs, provide in-depth analysis, and derive actionable insights that address underlying issues and drive business performance.
  • Foundation in statistical modeling, including segmentation, linear regression, and hypothesis testing.
  • Exceptional communication skills—both written and oral—suitable for presenting complex findings to all levels of the organization, with a particular emphasis on delivering insights to senior management and stakeholders.
  • Fluent with complex SQL queries and dataset transformations on large datasets.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills; act as a bridge among business, analytics and engineering teams.
  • Proven ability of delivering highly complex analytics projects involving methodology development, analysis, strategic recommendations, and presentation of the findings.
  • Confidence to scrutinize and share the limitations of our analyses when the data isn’t perfect.
  • Bachelor’s degree in applied Statistics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Market Analysis, or related fields; or relevant experience
Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time
  • Ability to stoop, kneel, bend at the waist, and reach daily
  • Able to lift and move up to 25 pounds occasionally
  • Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment
  • Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, from a remote office location.

Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go to mytbtotalrewards.com.

Work-Life Balance

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:
  • Meeting-Free Fridays (encouraged) | so you can catch up on work and self-development
  • Summer Fridays | from Memorial Day to Labor Day so you can enjoy a head-start to the weekend
  • Holiday Early Departure | close out early the business day before a company observed holiday
The starting salary for this position is $70,200 – $110,000 and may increase to $146,300 depending on merit, length of service with the Company, and other factors. We take into consideration an individual’s skills, background, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay information is based on market location and may be subject to prevailing wage laws, if applicable.
Note: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities or qualifications associated with this job.
